board: Jaycar / Duinotech XC3702 Barometric Pressure Sensor Module (SPL06-007, 4-pin VIN GND SCL SDA, I2C 0x76)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator, circuit board, footprint). The driver follows the Goertek datasheet: soft reset, COEF/SENSOR ready wait, table 10 coefficient decoding, table 4 scale factors, TMP_EXT=1, P_SHIFT above 8x, command-mode reads and the sec. 5.6 compensation formulas. The sim encodes the raw values with those same formulas.
